notes.KAITO_REFERENCE_APPROVED: Must be true (via ApprovalWorkflow + continuity) before bulk page generation. Mock references cannot open this gate.
notes.KAITO_MASTER_DESIGN_SELECTED: Set true only after a REAL master design candidate is human-selected.
notes.PILOT_APPROVED: Human pilot sign-off after REAL pages 1–5 are approved. Prior mock pilot approval was revoked (Phase 12).
notes.PDF_READY: Computed from approved art + gates; do not force true manually. Mock assets are never production PDF ready.
